title: The Tote
description:
Please note: the tote promo is available for the first 50 qualifying orders over $200. If the free tote code isn’t working, it means the available codes have already been used. Thank you for your understanding!

Are we perfect consumers? No. Are we easily influenced sometimes? Absolutely. But most of us are, hopefully, repeat outfit “offenders,” doing our best to be more thoughtful about how we consume, and what we support.

Our new totes are a subtle way to express some of the shared values and inside jokes that live within the ROWE community. They’re designed to be used daily, beat up a bit, and kept for years. 

And because it would feel a bit… ridiculous… to ask you to buy a tote that says Anti-Consumption Club… essentially consuming something to say you‘re anti consumption… all profits from that tote are being donated to The OR Foundation, supporting their work addressing the global impacts of fashion waste.

 

Details:

315 GSM

 

17.5" Width x 15" Height x 6.5” Depth

100% Cotton

These are made in India at a family owned factory. They are made from cotton sourced through a strictly controlled, vertically integrated supply chain. The mill oversees the entire process, from yarn to fabric to the finished tote bags, which are then heat pressed in Vancouver.

*All totes are final sale

title: The Fleece Sweatpant in 30”
description:
Our Canadian-knit and dyed fleece collection has arrived. At 350 GSM, this fabric is substantial, luxurious, and built to last, a true ROWE staple in the making. Lightly sueded on the face for a soft, elevated finish, and brushed on the inside for that unbeatable fleece-y comfort.

We’ve removed the spandex (goodbye plastic), so while it doesn’t have the stretch of previous seasons, it still has natural give and wears beautifully. This is a classic sweatpant weight, heavier and more structured than our past fleece. 

This pant is similar in fit to our jogger, but due to the fabric content, it will relax slightly with wear and return to shape after washing. The pattern has been slightly altered to accommodate the new fabric, though sizing remains largely the same. We recommend staying true to size for a relaxed fit, or sizing down if you prefer a more fitted look. For best results, refer to the waistband measurements in the size chart or check out a try on here.

Details

  • Fabric knit and dyed exclusively for ROWE in Canada

  • 100% organic cotton fleece (350 GSM)

  • Lightly sueded exterior, brushed fleece interior

  • Rib cuffs and waistband with 5% spandex for stretch and recovery

  • 2” elastic waistband

  • Side pockets

  • One back pocket (no back pocket on 28” inseam)

  • Cut and sewn in Canada

title: The Rib Tank
description:
Six months ago, I had the chance to buy some deadstock rib from a company that had just been purchased and moved most of their manufacturing overseas. Rib can be tricky, it can blow out, lose its shape, or shrink too much… but after sampling, I decided this batch was worth it. And now I finally get to share it with you: the Rib Collection!

This rib has a very different hand feel than our previous ones. Since it doesn’t have Tencel modal, it’s not as soft at first touch, but it softens beautifully with wear and has excellent longevity. There’s zero spandex (no plastic!) but still plenty of natural stretch. Because there’s no spandex, it’s a bit more relaxed, yet we’ve found it keeps its shape well, especially after washing.

Each color is slightly different. Please note that shrinkage, hand feel, and even measurements can vary a little between colors:

  • 100% organic cotton: Black, Pebble, Wild Rose
  • 100% cotton: Olivewood, Ash

Sizing + Care

Cut and sewn in Vancouver 🍁

 These fit true to size. We recommend staying with your usual size, or sizing down if you prefer a more fitted look. For most tops, we suggest using your bust measurement as the guide. You can also check out our sizing highlight for more details.

Wash cold with similar fabrics (avoid rough items like denim or velcro) and hang to dry. This fabric is not preshrunk, so expect a small amount of shrinkage after the first wash. As with most rib knits, it will relax slightly with wear but we’ve found it bounces back and holds its shape well.

Please note: colors may appear differently depending on your monitor or phone settings.

title: The Linen Short
description:
An easygoing linen short for many occasions. Light, breathable, and effortless on the body. Stick with your usual size for a relaxed, lived in feel. 
SIZING + CARE

Linen has a natural wrinkle which we love, and it only gets softer with wear. It will be a bit stiff when it's brand new! Please see our Instagram highlights for more sizing guidance. The white is a bit transparent, which you can see in our linen highlights. We think the white is the perfect beach cover up to show off a hint of your suit, or worn with nude underwear for a bit less show. The other colors are not transparent. 

  • 100% linen 
  • Please wash on a gentle cycle and hang to dry. Please note it will shrink slightly on first wash.
  • Cut and sewn in Vancouver 
  • 1" fold over waist

Linen is a durable fibre derived from flax, a hardy plant that requires less water than cotton and no fertilizers or pesticides to grow. Flax plants are also extremely versatile, meaning the entire plant can be used. The flax used is imported from Europe, cultivated without irrigation, and is GMO free.

These shorts pair perfectly with our linen shirt, tank or boxy tee.

*please note colors may vary greatly depending on your monitor and phone settings.
